title: Petlibro Feeder Jam Frequency
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petlibro:feeder
| stats count(eval(status="jam")) as jams by feeder
| where jams>0
| sort - jams
description: Uses Petlibro feeder logs telemetry to monitor how often each feeder jams during dispensing in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for meal automation risks before a feeding is missed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Petlibro feeder logs data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how often each feeder jams during dispensing so you can spot meal automation risks before a feeding is missed before it becomes annoying.
